To find the stationary points of an equation y = f(x), first find the derivative of the function, f'(x). Then, set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. If f''(x) is positive, the stationary point is a local minimum. If f''(x) is negative, the stationary point is a local maximum. If f''(x) is zero, the test is inconclusive.
